meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文平台榜单,提炼热门题材与市场趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想知道当前哪些网文题材最容易火,找准创作方向。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze web novel rankings to spot trending genres and market insights.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novelist wondering which genres are popular to guide your next story.

howto.what: Claude 会化身网文市场分析师：根据你指定的平台和题材方向，采集分析起点、番茄等平台的排行榜，提炼市场趋势与热门题材，输出扫榜报告，并给出 2-3 个选题建议。
howto.when: 当你使用 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜 命令，或说出「长篇什么火」等扫榜请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫榜起点月票榜，看看最近什么题材火。
say.note: 会采集起点月票榜并输出题材热度报告。

say.text: 番茄男频阅读榜前二十，提炼热门题材。
say.note: 按题材逐页采集番茄阅读榜，提取标签热词。

say.text: 对比起点和晋江的榜单，找找男女频趋势差异。
say.note: 会做跨平台对比分析，给出平台调性差异。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a web novel market analyst. Based on your chosen platform and genre direction, it collects and analyzes ranking data from platforms like Qidian and Fanqie, identifies market trends and hot topics, outputs a scan report, and proposes 2-3 actionable story ideas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you use commands like /story-long-scan or /长篇扫榜, or say phrases such as '长篇什么火' to request a ranking scan.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's monthly ticket ranking for me and see what genres are hot.
say_en.note: It will collect the ranking and output a genre heat report.

say_en.text: Take the top 20 on the Fanqie male channel reading list and extract hot themes.
say_en.note: Scrapes by category and extracts tag keywords.

say_en.text: Compare Qidian and Jinjiang rankings to spot male/female trend differences.
say_en.note: Gives cross-platform comparison and platform style differences.
